strategyTaxonomy.familyLabel: Core Low Cash + Lower Rebalance Threshold
strategyTaxonomy.operatorSummary: Keeps the winning core-universe low-cash structure for AI Infra but lowers the drift trigger so rebalance timing can compete under the richer path.

reasonCodes.label: Starts from the pinned AI Infra basket membership.
Selects names from the core universe.
Applies a 0% score boost to starter-basket names inside broader selection.
Ranks names by baseline signal score.
Weights names with the signal score proportional curve.
Raises ranking scores to the 1x power before weights are normalized.
Keeps 2% in the AUSD yield buffer.
Only rebalances after 275 bps of drift.

summaries.construction: 98% stays in xStocks across 5 names. 2% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 22%, AMDx 20.08%, AVGOx 19.3%.
summaries.benchmark: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 26.25% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +13.09%.
summaries.rebalance: Rebalance only when drift clears 275 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.35% annualized turnover, 12.08 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 98% turnover and 44.3 bps total costs with 2% parked in AUSD.
summaries.realityCheck: Authoritative scoring now uses 275 bps drift bands and implies 3.35% annualized turnover across 1 rebalance events; legacy static proxy remains available for comparison.
summaries.operator: Core Low Cash + Lower Rebalance Threshold keeps 98% in xStocks across 5 core universe names anchored to AI Infra, with 2% in AUSD.
